phases.label: Chapter 1 — the four parties
phases.note: Everyone you are handed while playing Hugo, Chris, Geddoe and Thomas' first chapters.

phases.label: Optional — Chapters 1-3
phases.note: The Budehuc-era recruits. Most open up as soon as you can travel; a few want a specific party or item.

phases.label: Chapters 2-3 — story
phases.note: Joins automatically as Hugo's and Chris' later chapters play out.

phases.label: Chapters 4-5 — story
phases.note: The armies gather at Budehuc; Yun joins a chapter later.

phases.label: Optional — Chapter 4 onward
phases.note: The second wave of optional recruits, once the parties have merged.

phases.label: Chapter 5 — story
phases.note: Geddoe's Chapter 5 group only joins if you stand and fight.

phases.label: Chapter 6 — the last four
phases.note: Joins in the final chapter, and only with every other star already recruited.

Chris.how: You control Chris during Chris' chapters.

Geddoe.how: You control Geddoe during Geddoe's chapters.

Hugo.how: You control Hugo during Hugo's chapters.

Thomas.how: You control Thomas during Thomas' chapters. If you do not play his chapters, he will join automatically in Chapter 4.

Aila.how: Joins automatically during Geddoe's Chapter 1, after Karaya Village is destroyed.

Shizu.how: Joins automatically at the end of Thomas' Chapter 1.

Arthur.how: Speak to him in the Mess Hall at Brass Castle. Examine the big oven in the kitchen. Go through the path. (This scene is different if Hugo does the recruiting.)

Augustine.how: Speak to him with the Rose Brooch in your inventory.

Belle.how: Get a Screw from a monster in Amur Plains. Give it to her, then ask her to join. (This scene is different if Hugo does the recruiting.)

Billy.how: Place an S statue (Hex Doll S, Knight Status S, etc.) in the statue room on the 2nd floor of Budehuc Castle. Leave, re-enter, and win a game of Goppu with Billy. (Save first!)

Dominic.how: Buy the Mole Armor from him.

Ernie.how: Speak to her in Brass Castle's Education Center. Answer all of her questions correctly.

Gordon.how: Bring one of the following parties to Iksay Village's item shop: 1. An all-male party 2. Your main character and Augustine 3. Chris plus whomever

Goro.how: Speak to him in the Zexen Forest with someone in your party who has the Appraisal skill.

Jeane.how: Go to Brass Castle's rune shop and ask her to join.

Kathy.how: Speak to her at Amur Plains North. Tell her how many horses she has.

Kidd.how: Talk to him at Duck Village's Inn. Assist him in his case.

Koroku.how: At Mt. Hei-Tou, take the first left, then the next left. Speak to the dog hiding on the left side of the screen.

Mel.how: Speak to her outside of Iksay Village's inn.

Mike.how: Speak to him in Caleria's Trade Post and win 20,000 at Kabu.

Mio.how: Speak to Mio and Tuta on the second floor of Iksay Village's inn.

Nadir.how: Speak to him on the top floor of Caleria's Inn with 3 men, 2 women, and 1 child in your active party (support doesn't count).

Nei.how: Speak to her on the screen to the right of the Guild Hall in Vinay del Zexay. Fight Guillaume in front of the Guild Hall. Ask her to join.

Peggi.how: Get the Iron Hammer from a man in the trading center in Great Hollow, then give it to Peggi in the Blacksmith in Great Hollow.

Sanae Y.how: After recruiting at least 50 Stars, resolve her conflict behind the Duck Village Inn.

Scott.how: Speak to Scott on the left side of Brass Castle, then give him a Deer Antler (from the Vinay del Zexay trading post).

Twaikin.how: Take the southeastern exit in the main Great Hollow room, follow the path, and speak to the dwarf in the next room. Then, say "Nothing" to the guard. Then ask him to join.

Watari.how: Find him behind a house on the right side of Iksay Village. Pay him 100,000 potch.

Ayame.how: Speak to Watari after recruiting him until you see a scene of North Cavern, then bring Watari to the end of the North Cavern. Watari must defeat her in a duel.

Kenji.how: First speak with a soldier inside Brass Castle who mentions seeing a man defeating monsters with cartwheels. Then find him in Yaza Plains exercising. Exercise with him, and then ask for a glass of water.

Melville.how: Must have completed Hugo Chapter 1. After recruiting Billy, speak with him until he mentions his son in Vinay del Zexay, then speak with Melville and Elliot in the alley of Vinay del Zexay.

Alanis.how: Speak to her in front of the fountain at Great Hollow with Melville and Elliot in your party.

Barts.how: Next to Iksay Village's windmill, give him a Grapes item (not Grape Seeds). You can buy Grapes C in Vinay del Zexay's trading post.

Edge.how: Fight him in a duel outside Le Buque's Rune Shop/Education Center.

Emily.how: Bring a party with more than 600 combined STR to [Chisha Villages]'s Tavern. Beat her at arm-wrestling.

Estella.how: After the events at Alma Kinan, speak to her at Alma Kinan's Inn. Agree to help her. Speak to a girl at Alma Kinan's ceremonial cite, and then speak to Estella again.

Guillaume.how: After stopping him from chasing Shabon, beat him in a duel in front of the Sindar Gate in the Ancient Highway.

Landis.how: Leave one slot in your active party open and fight in the second screen (coming from Duck Village) of Kuput Forest. He'll just appear in your party without notice. This may take a while.

Mamie.how: Upstairs in Duck Village's appraisal shop, give her a Crab Rice Bowl.

Wan Fu.how: Talk to him downstairs from Chisha Village's Item Shop. Pay 3000 potch for his food.

Futch.how: Speak to him on the mountain path to Caleria. Agree to help him find Sharon. Chase Sharon around Caleria, and he will join.

Hortez.how: Speak to him at Duck Village, Chisha Village and then Caleria. Speak to him in Duck Village again, and give him the wrong directions.

Jefferson.how: Leave Budehuc through the front gate with neither Juan nor Cecile in your party.

Rhett.how: Speak to him at Duck Village with [Sgt. Joe] in your party.

Tuta.how: Bring Mio to Chisha Village. Go to the underground portion of the village and talk to Tuta in the middle room.

Viki.how: Enter the Mountain Path from Karaya Village. Let her stay at Budehuc.

Viki (Young).how: Enter the Mountain Path from Karaya Village with Viki in the party. Let her stay at Budehuc.

Duke.how: Joins during Geddoe Chapter 5 if you don't run away.

Elaine.how: Joins during Geddoe Chapter 5 if you don't run away.

Franz.how: Joins during Geddoe Chapter 5 if you don't run away.

Gau.how: Joins during Geddoe Chapter 5 if you don't run away.

Iku.how: Joins during Geddoe Chapter 5 if you don't run away.

Nicolas.how: Joins during Geddoe Chapter 5 if you don't run away.

Ruby.how: Joins during Geddoe Chapter 5 if you don't run away.

Albert.how: Joins automatically during Chapter 6. You must have all other stars recruited.

Luc.how: Joins automatically during Chapter 6. You must have all other stars recruited.

Sarah.how: Joins automatically during Chapter 6. You must have all other stars recruited.

Yuber.how: Joins automatically during Chapter 6. You must have all other stars recruited.

extras.how: After recruiting Koroku and your Flame Champion moves into Budehuc, find him in North Cavern (second hallway screen from entrance). Koichi is not a star.
extras.name: Koichi

extras.how: After recruiting Koichi, find her in the Great Hollow monster area (the hallway that Geddoe did not access in his Chapter 1). Connie is not a star.
extras.name: Connie

extras.how: After recruiting Connie, find him in the Mt. Senai (hanging off the edge of the open deadend area). Kosanji is not a star.
extras.name: Kosanji

extras.how: After recruiting Kosanji, find him in the Sindar Ruins within Ancient Highway (from the entrance, make a left then an immediate left to a dead end, his tail is visible in the upper right corner of the area). Kogoro is not a star.
extras.name: Kogoro
